policies.title: Hong Kong SAR ordinary passport: Category A visa exemption
policies.summary: El Salvador's current Foreign Ministry ordinary-passport table expressly includes Hong Kong among the Special Administrative Regions of the PRC and assigns Category A, exempt from visa.
conditions: The table distinguishes ordinary from diplomatic, official and service passports; this policy is only for the ordinary Hong Kong SAR passport row.
The table separately describes treatment of British passports held by Hong Kong-origin travellers. It does not change this direct Hong Kong SAR ordinary-passport classification.
Purpose, CA-4 stay limits, passport validity, carrier, security and final admission conditions remain outside this visa-category classification.

conflicts.explanation: The current Foreign Ministry table expressly assigns Hong Kong's ordinary-passport row Category A, exempt from visa; the fallback still says visa_required.

unresolved.reason: The current Foreign Ministry table expressly names Hong Kong but does not directly name or map a Macao SAR ordinary passport. Omission is not used to establish the fallback visa_required label.
